rules: A URL IS NEVER INVENTED. status 'ready' requires a source_url copied from a file in this repository; the copy is cited in `note`. A job this repository holds no URL for is 'needs_source' and is skipped by --run.
status 'needs_key' is a paid or credentialled feed. It is not a missing URL, it is a purchase the principal has not made.

window_et is ET wall clock, closed-closed, converted through America/New_York so DST needs no special case. window_basis says WHERE the two times came from: 'declared' means this record chose an operational band, and such a band is never to be read as a published release clock.
frequency and content are the deposit's own table cells, verbatim, for the ten jobs it names.
Gap detection covers ready daily and weekly jobs only; intraday jobs are named as not-checked by check_gaps_scope rather than silently omitted.

jobs.name: bls_cpi_schedule
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an operational band for a forward schedule page, not a published release clock. BLS releases CPI at 08:30 ET; this job records the SCHEDULE page, not the release.
jobs.content: BLS forward CPI release schedule page
jobs.note: URL copied from scripts/fetch_release_calendar.py:552 and data/calendar/SOURCES.md ('bls.gov/schedule/news_release/{cpi,empsit}.htm runs only to the December 2026 release'). Not one of the deposit's ten; recorded because it is keyless, already fetched here, and the forward page is the only source of a release clock the year pages do not yet carry.

jobs.name: bls_empsit_schedule
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an operational band for a forward schedule page, not a published release clock.
jobs.content: BLS forward Employment Situation release schedule page

jobs.name: fed_fomc_calendar
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an operational band. FOMC statements print their own clock ('For release at 2:00 p.m. EST') and that clock lives in the statement, not in this page.
jobs.content: Federal Reserve FOMC meeting calendar page
jobs.note: URL copied from scripts/fetch_release_calendar.py:562,593. D585 records ten meetings whose dates are sourced and whose release clock is not yet published (2026-10-28, 2026-12-09, all eight 2027 meetings); a forward recorder is exactly how those clocks arrive.

jobs.name: eia_wpsr_schedule
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an operational band for a schedule page. EIA's own standard sentence on this page gives 10:30 ET Wednesday for the RELEASE; that is the release clock, not this job's window.
jobs.content: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report schedule page (standard sentence plus exception table)
jobs.note: URL copied from scripts/fetch_release_calendar.py:99. D585: the live page carries roughly two years of exceptions, so recording it forward is how the exception table is kept without Wayback.

jobs.name: eia_ngsr_schedule
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an operational band for a schedule page; the release clock on it is 10:30 ET Thursday.
jobs.content: EIA Natural Gas Storage Report schedule page

jobs.name: cme_settlement_times
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an operational band. The page states the settlement WINDOWS (energy 14:28-14:30 ET); those are the object recorded, not this job's own window.
jobs.content: CME 'Daily Settlement Time Details' Confluence page - the settlement WINDOW TIMES, with its version date
jobs.note: URL read out of the cached response itself, data/raw/cme_settlement/confluence_457085528_daily-settlement-time-details__fetched_at_2026-09-21T1930Z.json -> _links.self, and matching the route template in data/settlement_flow/SOURCES.md. THIS IS NOT the deposit's 'CME settlement' row: that row is settlement PRICES, and this repository holds no URL for those (see cme_settlement_prices below). D586 records that curl to www.cmegroup.com returns HTTP 403 from this machine ('This IP address is blocked due to suspected web scraping activity'); the Confluence route answers anonymously with HTTP 200.

jobs.name: cftc_cot_weekly
jobs.window_basis: SOURCED: scripts/fetch_cftc_cot.py:89 - 'COT is surveyed at Tuesday's close and published Friday at 15:30 ET'. The window opens at the stated release instant and closes at 23:00 ET the same Friday, which is declared.
jobs.content: Disaggregated positions for NG and CL
jobs.note: The deposit's 'CFTC COT (v1.6)' row, and the one of its ten this repository can already fetch keylessly. Base resource composed exactly as scripts/fetch_cftc_cot.py:358 composes it, from API = 'https://publicreporting.cftc.gov/resource' (:137) and DATASETS['disaggregated'] = '72hh-3qpy' (:146). Per-root filtering ($where on cftc_contract_market_code) is the parser's job and no query parameters are invented here. FUTURES ONLY: the futures-and-options variants (jun7-fc8e, kh3c-gbw2, yw9f-hn96) exist and are deliberately not used, because an options-inclusive position is not a futures position.

jobs.name: fund_snapshot
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an evening band, after the deposit's 'after each fund's publication'. No issuer publication clock is sourced in this repository, so the band is operational and nothing more.
jobs.content: Holdings (contract months, futures vs swap notional), NAV, shares/units outstanding, stated and effective leverage, for all US and P9 products
jobs.note: Deposit job 1. This repository holds no issuer holdings URL for BOIL, KOLD, UCO, SCO, UNG, USO or the P9 products, and none is invented. Deposit Q14 is the open question for the P9 half.

jobs.name: cme_settlement_prices
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an afternoon band after the energy settlement window (14:28-14:30 ET, D586). Not a published posting time for the price file - CME's posting clock is not sourced here.
jobs.content: Settlement prices for all held contract months
jobs.note: Deposit job 2, and DISTINCT from cme_settlement_times above: that job records when the settlement window IS, this one would record what settled. www.cmegroup.com returns HTTP 403 to curl from this machine (D586), so even a known URL would need the browser route; no settlement-price URL is held here at all.

jobs.name: tas_summary
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an after-session band. The TAS instruments' own clocks are part of deposit Q3, unresolved.
jobs.frequency: Daily (plus trade-level if not buying history)
jobs.content: TAS volume, aggressor split, premium ticks
jobs.note: Deposit job 3. Databento, paid; deposit Q3 ('Databento TAS symbology and history coverage for NG and CL') is open. The key lives outside the repository at ~/.config/databento/key (scripts/run_futures_acquisition.py:42) and is never printed, logged or placed in a URL.

jobs.name: etf_quotes
jobs.window_basis: SOURCED from the deposit itself, section 2: '1-minute NBBO quote midpoints and trades ... for BOIL, KOLD, UCO, SCO, UNG, USO, 09:30-16:00 ET'.
jobs.frequency: Intraday, 1-min (only if not purchasing history, Q8)
jobs.content: NBBO mid and trades for the six US ETFs
jobs.note: Deposit job 4. Deposit Q8 ('source, venue coverage and history for all six ETFs') is unresolved, so there is no URL to copy. Intraday: not covered by gap detection, and check_gaps_scope names it.

jobs.name: attention
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): the whole day, because the deposit's cadence for this job is every 15 minutes (GDELT) and hourly (Wikipedia), which is not a window.
jobs.frequency: GDELT every 15 min; Wikipedia hourly; social if Q12 resolves
jobs.note: Deposit job 5. No GDELT or Wikipedia endpoint is recorded anywhere in this repository, so none is written here. The social part is gated on deposit Q12 (a lawfully obtained timestamped archive) and stays disabled until it resolves.

jobs.name: restrike_check
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): the US cash session, the band inside which an intraday restrike could be detected.
jobs.content: Computed restrike events for WisdomTree 3x products, with price evidence
jobs.note: Deposit job 6, and the one row of its ten that is NOT A FETCH: a restrike event is COMPUTED from a price series, so what a recorder can honestly store is the price evidence it was computed from. Deposit D21 models restrikes explicitly; deposit section 13A.7 says contractual mechanics are applied in all tracks and never traded. No price URL for the P9 products is held here.

jobs.name: swap_dissemination
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an evening band. No SDR publication clock is sourced in this repository.
jobs.content: NG, crude and commodity-index-linked swap records
jobs.note: Deposit job 8. No swap data repository URL exists anywhere in this repository. Deposit unit test 44: such records are keyed on DISSEMINATION time, not execution time, for any predictive use - which is the same availability rule this module enforces with fetched_at.

jobs.name: options_oi
jobs.window_basis: declared here (D608): an evening band, after open interest is published for the prior session.
jobs.content: NG and CL options open interest by strike
jobs.note: Deposit job 9. Deposit unit test 50: options OI is joined point-in-time, the PRIOR day's published values only. No URL held; www.cmegroup.com 403s from this machine (D586). D581 is the warning about what a parent options symbol resolves to before a pull is quoted.

jobs.name: mbo_around_windows
jobs.window_basis: SOURCED, both ends. The deposit says 'Daily, 13:30 ET to W_end'; W_end for NG and CL is the energy settlement window close, 14:30 ET, from D586's CME table ('Energy Products 14:28:00-14:30:00 ET') and the deposit's own section 4 ('about 14:28-14:30 ET for NG and CL').
jobs.content: Order-level data for traded contract months
jobs.note: Deposit job 10. Databento CME MBO, paid; deposit Q22 ('history start date, cost for the traded NG/CL months around settlement windows') is open. Note the free-window caution recorded in this repository: the GLBX archive's free re-fetch window trails the date by roughly a month, so an MBO recorder that stops for a month is not recoverable at zero cost.
